sub: Can a short test size a decoy maze? {agent} entered it {n_ent} times, up to {cap} model calls each. We took its chance of leaving per page on pages 1-3, then checked where half the runs left.
start: A hidden link leads into the maze; no maze page has the answer. Page 2, as the agent reads it:
ex_desc: run {run} of {n_ent}: the run whose depth matches the agent's typical (median) depth
end_answer: gave up: said the figure is not there
end_get: gave up: went back to the site
end_lost: got lost: asked for a page that does not exist
p1_s: about 1 run in {one_in} leaves on each page
p3_s: {giveup_n} runs gave up, {cap_n} hit the limit
lab_none: more than half still inside at the limit
axis: maze page where half the runs had left (log scale)
key: Page where half the runs had left (log scale). Hollow dot: forecast from pages 1-3. Filled dot: real. Band: within 2x of the real page, the pass line we set in advance.
foot: MOCK: scripted agents through our real test website; gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3-8B data pending
